about.headline: The chippy you wish you'd found first.
about.body: Most people have been burned by a tradie at some point. What they want is simple: someone who turns up on time, communicates, and doesn't cut corners to finish early. Every job is done that way, from a garden edge to a full deck.

realReviews.author: Vini Pyx
realReviews.text: After doing renovations for nearly two years I have found the best contractor I have ever had. He was on time, respectful and knowledgeable, fast at responding to any requests. I would hire him again time and time over. Overall such precise and accurate work. He built this retaining wall and then we asked if he could build some steps and a garden edge. You will have zero regrets hiring Jaime. Some fefore and afters :)

realReviews.author: Jonathan Johnny-moore
realReviews.text: I used JSQ Carpentry to do some installation work on my house and I was very pleased with the quality of the work. Jaime was very professional, reliable and honest in his dealings with me. I would definitely hire him again.

realReviews.author: bharath reddy
realReviews.text: I wish I could have found him earlier. After multiple bad contractors finally found Jamie who is the best contractor I ever hired . He is on time professional, accommodating and didn't took one single shortcut to finish the job. He is on-time, patient and always communicated well. I am confident that he is my go to tradie from now on .

finalCta.headline: Got a carpentry job in mind?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a written quote before anything is booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straightforward chat about the job.

faq.a: Send the job through the form or give Jaime a ring. We'll have a look and send a written quote with the scope and price.
Brisbane and surrounds, from Caboolture and North Lakes down to Ipswich and Beenleigh. Close by but not on the list? Ask anyway.

faq.q: Do you build retaining walls and garden edges?
faq.a: Yes. Retaining walls, steps and garden edging are part of the work, as well as decks and general carpentry.
Ask when you request your quote and we'll send the licence and insurance details for your job.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to book a time to look at the job.
